proof_dependency_certification.measure: Lean .thmInfo.value.getUsedConstants restricted to immutable base, four prior overlays and this overlay's public source theorem nodes

native_axiom_census.scope: Every theorem constant owned by the five compiled source modules, including private and generated theorem constants; other native public names are not assumed to be source declarations

lexical_pr_preflight.note: Existing PR parser and name-hint algorithm on actual immutable-base and frozen worktree bytes; hints are not proof dependencies or type-equality certification.

native_export_evidence.scope: Actual fixed-verifier output for all 126 theorem constants owned by the five compiled modules: type displays, stored universe parameters, all direct proof constants, direct theorem constants, ownership and transitive axiom closure. The 73 public source candidates additionally carry registered direct proof edges.

native_execution.source_binding: All builds and native checks use the exact added-module and public-root SHA256 values in this overlay; fixed and initial native JSON objects match in every field.
